name: Field Notes
concept: A quiet editorial field guide couples a ruled three-column proof index with an active desktop reading locator.
silhouette: left editorial masthead + ruled proof index; single-column notes on phone
interaction: Pointer, touch, or keyboard focus on a proof row updates its highlighted rule and desktop locator; the mobile list and no-JavaScript fallback are fully readable.
safety: Both potentially misleading claims carry adjacent illustrative qualifications; the locator is an index, not a metric.
